title: Open threats by severity
description: Threats not yet acknowledged or cleared, whatever their age.
viz_content: SELECT severity, count() AS threats FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_threats) WHERE status = '' OR status = 'open' GROUP BY severity ORDER BY severity

title: Detections over time by rule
viz_content: SELECT format_datetime(to_datetime(int_div(to_unix_timestamp(detected_at), greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))) * greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))), '%m-%d %H:%M') AS time, rule_name, count() AS detections FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_security_events) WHERE detected_at > now() - {{filter_time_range}} GROUP BY time, rule_name ORDER BY time

title: Detections by rule and tool
description: Which rule fired on which tool: the eight most frequent pairs.
viz_content: SELECT rule_id, rule_name, severity, tool_name, count() AS detections, uniq(session_id) AS sessions, max(detected_at) AS last_seen FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_security_events) WHERE detected_at > now() - {{filter_time_range}} GROUP BY rule_id, rule_name, severity, tool_name ORDER BY detections DESC LIMIT 8

title: Sessions with the most detections
description: The eight sessions with the most critical detections. Copy a session id into the Session Trace dashboard to see what the agent did.
viz_content: SELECT session_id, any(agent_id) AS agent_id, count() AS detections, count_if(severity = 'critical') AS critical, uniq(rule_id) AS rules, max(detected_at) AS last_seen FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_security_events) WHERE detected_at > now() - {{filter_time_range}} GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY critical DESC, detections DESC LIMIT 8

title: Blocked actions
description: The last 100 events a rule or a hold blocked, the latest at the bottom.
viz_content: SELECT * FROM (SELECT event_time AS time, agent_type, session_id, event_type, tool_name, hook_decision, block_reason FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND hook_decision NOT IN ('', 'observe', 'allow') ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 100) ORDER BY time

title: Recent threats
description: The 100 most recent threats (one per agent, session and rule), the latest at the bottom.
viz_content: SELECT * FROM (SELECT last_seen, severity, rule_name, agent_id, session_id, if(status = '', 'open', status) AS status FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_threats) WHERE last_seen > now() - {{filter_time_range}} ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 100) ORDER BY last_seen
